integrity: The proof uses the exact auxiliary function and parameter reduction in the primary source. Pointwise strictness follows from the source's no-critical-point theorem plus its one-sided boundary derivative, and extremizing-sequence rigidity follows from the source's boundary estimates, compactness, uniform convergence to the one-variable profile, and uniqueness of that profile's maximizer. No finite experiment or numerical optimization is used.
scientific_limitations: The result proves nonattainment for distinct pairs and rigidity only of the two scalar parameters appearing in the sharp proof. It does not classify normalized function-level extremizing sequences and does not extend the claim to the source's quasiregular Bloch-type estimates.
title: Nonattainment and parameter rigidity at the sharp pseudo-hyperbolic Bloch constant
